---
title: Studio
description: A four-person design studio in Melbourne. The template the demo runs on.
---

Northlight Studio: four staff across marketing, finance and sales, three
customers, a price list and a handful of processes.

```bash
npx staffroom init --template studio
npx staffroom init --template studio --tools    # with the five example tools
```

## Who is in it

| Agent | Department | Does |
|---|---|---|
| `copywriter` | marketing | Turns briefs into landing page copy. |
| `designer` | marketing | Produces image briefs and alt text. |
| `bookkeeper` | finance | Reconciles invoices and chases what is owed. |
| `prospector` | sales | Finds and shortlists prospects. |

## The sample business

The brain comes with notes about Northlight Studio so the office has something to
show on the first morning. The first time you run live, the office asks once
whether to clear them out. Say yes and they move to `brain/90-archive/_sample/`,
where the index skips them — the files stay, they just stop being read as fact
about your business.

Your own notes are never touched either way.
